description: This file is a shell script that manages versioning information for the project, including retrieving tagged versions and the latest git commit hash.

methods.name: tagged_version
methods.description: Retrieves the exact matching git tag for the current commit, if any, and outputs it after stripping a specific prefix.

methods.name: development_version
methods.description: Constructs a development version string based on the PRPLOS_DEVELOPMENT_VERSION variable and the latest git commit hash.
